children.raw_text: (1) Every person who contravenes or fails to comply with any provision of this Law or any regulation, rule, order, direction or requirement made or given thereunder shall be guilty of an offence under this Law, and shall, on conviction after summary trial before a Magistrate, be liable to a fine not exceeding fifty thousand rupees or to imprisonment of either description for a term not exceeding two years or to both such fine and imprisonment.

body.heading: Retrospective effect of certain amendments
body.raw_text: 11. The amendments made in the principal enactment by section 4 and paragraphs (6) and (c) off section 5 of this Act shall be deemed to have taken effect on October 1,1978.
body.text: The amendments made in the principal enactment by section 4 and paragraphs (6) and (c) off section 5 of this Act shall be deemed to have taken effect on October 1,1978.

body.heading: Validation of certain acts done without legal authority by officer of local authority
body.raw_text: 12. "Where prior to the date of commencement of this Act, any officer of a local authority has on behalf of the Urban Development Authority, done any act in the exercise, performance or discharge of any power, duty or function relating to planning within any area declared to be a development area under section 3 of the principal enactment, such act shall not be deemed to have been or to be invalid by reason only of the fact that such officer was not legally empowered to exercise, perform or discharge such power, duty or function.
